provenance.source: new: 2026-10-22 real-host bug. After `murmo init`, `;rvw` plus space stayed literal in packed Claude Code 2.1.306 while the same project expanded it in Pi and OpenCode: the Claude adapter loaded only the personal murmo.toml. `projectTrust` is applied by the harness with `murmo trust` before the host starts
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: A shortcut from an approved project .murmo.toml expands on Space on every host (phase 14 trust, phase 15 installed-artifact check).

A cloned repository's shortcuts never expand before the user reviewed them, on any host (phase 14 trust). A host that never loads project config also leaves the draft literal, so this case means something only beside trusted-project-shortcut-expands in the same run; the review notice itself is checked by packages/adapters/claude/test/project-config.gate.ts.
A [replace] table's field default is inserted, not its placeholder. Every host once inserted `Review <change> for correctness.`: the adapters copied only shortcut, text and origin into the compiler.
